Results.ReviewText: This is really a nice medium to small grill , but does everything we need a grill for.
Results.Title: Nice grill

Results.ReviewText: Great grill! I am learning to grill for the first time in my own using a propane grill and I was worried at first that I wouldn’t be successful but this little grill is great. It lights easily, maintains even heat and I’ve made some great meals on it so far. My kids beg me to grill and don’t ask for fast food as much when I can make such good food at home.
Results.Title: User friendly for a new griller

Results.ReviewText: This is an amazing grill. We have had several different brands and this Weber by far exceeds our expectations for any grill! I am  so glad that we bought a high quality grill. It doesn’t get Smoky and make a huge mess. It is very easy to clean up. We love it!! The heat is so easy  to control. It’s the best!
Results.Title: What A Grest Quality Grill!!

Results.ReviewText: I can’t find a griddle for this grill. Please someone help me!
Results.Title: Griddle??

Results.ReviewText: The customer service and tech support is stellar. I had some trouble setting up the grill. When I contacted tech support they were friendly and genuinely concerned about helping me. How unusual and refreshing is that in this day and age! And let me say the quality of the grill is excellent. I've owned two grills before this one, both different brands, and the Weber is by far the best quality.
Results.Title: Customer Service is Stellar!

Results.ReviewText: Love the grill, cooks, evenly and hot, well built.
Results.Title: Father’s Day gift.

Results.ReviewText: So far great. Replacing an old Q300 that had accumulated too many little things (intermittent shorting/shocking with igniter). Grill space a bit smaller now. Warming rack still seems to be in the way. Likely will take it off soon. Food taking a bit longer to cook than it used to but I think that’s me getting used to new burner arrangement. Love the no battery igniters though still double checking flame on because it shouldn’t be this easy.
Results.Title: Great now that I’m learning it

Results.ReviewText:
I love the compactness of the grill .
The searing feature is quite good.
The only problem I have had is getting the main burner to light up quickly.
It takes two or 3 tries to get it going.
Results.Title: Very nice grill

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for your feedback. Your satisfaction is very important to us. So sorry to hear about the issue with your flavor bars and the grill not heating quickly. Our Care team is here to help. Please look for an outreach email from us soon. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: We are used to grills that heat and cook quickly. It takes a lot longer to heat. You have to turn on all burners and preheat. The covers for the flame are rusted after 7 uses. It's a sturdy grill and hopefully will last.
Results.Title: Not what we're used to

Results.ReviewText: At first I balked at the price compared to other brands but I gambled on the Name and purchased anyway.  What a decision, this grill is awesome and cleanup is a snap. Food comes out great and the searing on this grill is second to none.  Only complaint are the plastic wheels that are not of the quality of the rest of the grill.  Go buy this grill and grill like a pro!
Results.Title: Weber Spirit is Awesome

Results.ReviewText: Perfect grill for two people use. Heats up fast using turbo  button when doing steaks. Also economical for propane usage. Love the 10 year warranty.
Results.Title: Weber BBQ stands out if you want Quality

Results.ReviewText: We love the grill.  The only downside is the fact that the assembly brochure was NOT for our grill, so we had to figure out how to put it together without instructions. It was over the Memorial Day weekend, so the store wasn't open when we realized that, after having taken everything out of the box.  We figured it out fnally!!
Results.Title: Wrong instructions

Results.ReviewText: Great Weber guality. Won't ever buy any other brand.
Results.Title: Quality grill

Results.ReviewText: Perfect size for a retired couple who love to grill.
Results.Title: Perfect size.

Results.ReviewText: Awesome and works great. Went from a 5 burner to a 3 burner and I love it
Results.Title: Awesome grill would recommend this to any friends

Results.ReviewText: I love the grill BUT the side trays are a weak design. I put a tray on it and it fell to the ground. The side trays are my only complaint.
Results.Title: Poor tray design

Results.ReviewText: These grills works fantastic, no flare-ups, no over-heated meats, just the best steaks to eat.
Results.Title: Spirit Grill

Results.ReviewText: Since natural gas isn't colored, I can't tell if the flame is lit.  The only way to tell is by heat output.  I don't think this is a Weber grill issue, I think it's just me getting used to using a natural gas barbque.
Results.Title: Can't see the flame

Results.ReviewText: First time buying a Weber, and it’s wonderful. Warms fast and the sear zone is amazing. Highly recommend a Weber grill, very sturdy as well.
Results.Title: Excellent Grill

Results.ReviewText: It does a decent job in doing meats.  The lid handle gets too hot to handle - not like the one I purchased 8 years ago.
Results.Title: another weber grill for me

Results.ReviewText: We bought the natural gas 3 burner Weber and love it! Large cooking surface, heats up quickly, easy to clean. Looked at several different brands and are VERY happy with our choice!
Results.Title: Love it!

Results.ReviewText: More than what I expected.  Very pleased and will refer it to anyone looking for a grill
Results.Title: Great peoduct

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for your feedback. We are really sorry to hear two igniters stopped working. Our Care team wants to know more and offer our assistance to get you back up and running again. Please look for an outreach email from us soon. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: Ok grill but not worth the premium price.  After using it just once the two ignitors for the right two burners stopped working.  I get by ok but only with the help of 11” matches to light the right 2 burners.   The mechanical “snap” ignitors are junk.  This grill was about 2 times the price of other good brands which use a far more dependable battery operated ignitor.  Webber was recommended by friends but I wont be recommending it.
Results.Title: Overpriced

Results.ReviewText: Good grill overall. Sear zone is everything you want and expect. But for the price and being a 3 burner, instead of 2, the size is a problem. One star less because of the small size.
Results.Title: Good grill, small size

Results.ReviewText: I am disappointed with the amount of flareup this grill has. Previously I owned a Char Broil and didn't have flare-up at all, but each time I use this grill, regardless of the meat type or settings, I experience this issue.
Results.Title: Bad Flare-up

Results.ReviewText: Very impressed with the quality of the grill. Great that it included all connections (including the hose) for the natural gas hookup. First few uses have been a big success. The grill surface does not stick. No flare-ups. Nice grill marks on the food, and even heating. Overall it is a very compact package with a surprisingly large cooking area. It did take a while to assemble, but the instructions (especially the app version) were clear.
Results.Title: Bigger cook surface than it looks

Results.ReviewText: The BBQ works well overall, but I have a few concerns. I wish it had 4 proper wheels instead of just 2, it’s difficult to move, especially for seniors. There’s also no proper handle to push it easily. While the foldable side racks are convenient for storage, they don’t help much when you need to relocate the BBQ
Results.Title: Weber Spirit E-325 Gas Grill

Results.ReviewText: This grill is definitely 💯 per cent fantastic.  You don’t even hear it when you initially turn it on and it heats incredibly quickly.  It also cooks meat at an alarming rate so you don’t have to sweat while you’re grilling your favorite foods.   I strongly recommend it since the price is right as well.
Results.Title: Sizzling

Results.ReviewText: After many trips to look at BBQs I decided on the Weber Spirit E-325 and I do not regret my decision. The classic black look and large gas control dials make this Weber look great on my deck. The sear zones put the perfect marks on my steaks, the temp dial is accurate and the folding side shelves make this one of the best BBQs I’ve ever owned, not to mention the accessories you can get to replace the side shelves. My only issue is why they don’t include a propane tank with the purchase, it’s only a small gesture but would be highly appreciated by many of us! I definitely recommend the Weber Spirit and even tho I’m in my 50’s the best choice I made was having the store put it together for me.
Results.Title: A classic Bar-B-Que.

Results.ReviewText: Sear zone works ok. Hotter than normal, but not hot enough
Results.Title: Sear Zone

Results.ReviewText: Spirit E-325 makes grilling easy and fun !!!! New searing burners are GREAT !!!!
Results.Title: Weber Spirit E325 Grill

Results.ReviewText: I needed to replace my old Weber gas grill.  I reviewed on line all the Weber 3 burner gas grills and picked out the Spirit E-325.  I bought the unit from Lowes who assembled the grill and delivered it to my house.  I hook up the gas tank and it was ready to go.  Have cooked several meals of stakes or hamburgers and they all turned out well.  The grill is clean and nest.  I like the heavy duty cooking grates on Weber grills.  Overall I am well pleased and would recommend it to anyone.
Results.Title: New Replacement Grill

Results.ReviewText: This is my third Weber Spirit gas grill. The first two lasted 13 and 10 years, respectivel. The new E 325 grill heats up very quickly and cooks the food evenly. I like that each burner is independent and has its own starter.However, I’m not entirely confident that this girl will last as long. The grill body appears to be less sturdy as the metal feels thinner than previous generations. It no longer comes with a gauge that gives me an idea of how much propane is left in the tank. I’m crossing my fingers that it holds up for a decade but I won’t bet on it.
Results.Title: Good Grill But…

Results.ReviewText: Another sold Weber grill.  It doesn’t seem to get hot enough on medium heat but does fine on high and I have not had occasion yet to use the blaster function
Results.Title: Typical Weber Quality

Results.ReviewText:
Grill works great and the searing burners have been very useful.
One suggestion I would make, would be to place caster wheels on the opposite end of the existing wheels, to make it easier to roll around on a garage floor.
Results.Title: Great grilll. One suggestion!

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for your feedback. We appreciate your comments regarding your grill  not cooking as efficiently. We want to know more and offer our assistance. Please look for an outreach email from us soon. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: Grill is ok.  Had a Weber previously that lasted for 30 years and that one cooked quicker and more efficiently at 30 years old than this one has at two months old.
Results.Title: New Weber

Results.ReviewText: We've used Weber bbq's for years and decided to switch to gas from propane. Glad we did. Very quick cook and the sear feature is great
Results.Title: Very Happy with Purchase

ClientResponses.Response: Your feedback means a lot to us. So sorry to hear you are not satisfied with the tank placement and the handle getting too hot. We are here to help. Please look for an outreach email from our Care team soon. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: Disappointed with this grill. Tank placement. Hot handle.
Results.Title: Disappointed with this grill. Tank placement.

Results.ReviewText: Great grill love the searing option .The only negative would be when using searing feature you need a oven mitt to open cover Handel gets very hot
Results.Title: Review 325-E Spirit Grill

Results.ReviewText: Excellent - only suggestion is more robust wheels.   Easy on, easy off, very sturdy and quick ignition.
Results.Title: Spirit® E-325 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)

Results.ReviewText:
Our old barbecue was large with a separate searing burner and a pot/frying pan burner plus the sides did not collapse to make it smaller. 
This is a 3 burner, with two of the burners that max out for searing. I was able to cook 12 Costco burgers and 6 wieners at one time on the grill. 
The temperature can be constant when used. I did find that the thermostat was not accurate when compared to separate temperature probes. 
Over all it works great. I do fell it is over priced for what you get, plus having to assemble it at that cost, and buying the cover was an extra $100.00 this is way over priced for a cover. Bought at Home Depot.
Results.Title: Down Sized

Results.ReviewText: Perfect little grill - it’s just me- and a few friends on occasion-
Results.Title: Small and compact even cooking

Results.ReviewText: This bbq grill is so efficient and its easy to use.
Results.Title: WEBER BETTER

1500789.Description: Grill food that tastes better than ever on the reinvented 3-burner Spirit® E-325 Gas Grill with Sear Zone. Ignite each individual burner easily with one hand with Snap-Jet Ignition and control the heat precisely with a full range of temperatures from high to low and everything in between. Make the most of your space by adding a variety of Weber Works™ snap-on accessories (sold separately) to the side rails.
